A '''jet-tub''' was a large, oval-shaped personal hygiene device. The [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Slythor]] had a jet-tub installed aboard his personal pleasure vehicle, ''[[The Peeve]]''. He spent several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] per [[Standard day/Legends|day]] in the jet-tub.
